diagnostic_causes.forced_reflow: Reported frames are in the Flutter-generated main.dart.mjs JS/Wasm runtime imports for DOM focus and layout/scroll reads (focus, width/offsetWidth, scrollTop). App-owned bootstrap only assigns input IDs and does not read layout. Runtime edits or suppressing semantics/focus were not used.
diagnostic_causes.performance: Flutter engine initialization, Wasm/font transfer and JavaScript execution remain. Japanese font fallback and standard SDK localization are retained for correct rendering.
diagnostic_causes.target_size: Flutter semantics exposes clipped portions of 36px sidebar rows as small targets; inherited SDK limitation. Controls were not hidden from accessibility.
diagnostic_causes.source_maps: Matching SkWasm map is not shipped by the pinned SDK; app Wasm, generated loader and bootstrap maps are served.
diagnostic_causes.deprecation: Pinned Flutter engine browser detection refers to Intl.v8BreakIterator.
